feature: Size mode measures the shapes you drew
summary: Point the ruler's Size mode at a rectangle you drew and it lights up and offers its width and height, the same way it already did for a button in a screenshot. The numbers come from the box the app drew, so they are exact rather than read off pixels.
setup: Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next. Nothing to turn on.

try.do: Make a new blank canvas, any size.
Press R and drag out a rectangle in the middle of it.
Press Escape, then press I for the ruler, and set Mode to Size.
Rest the pointer in the middle of your rectangle.
Click once: a width and a height land on the picture and two rows land under Measurements.
Now open a screenshot, draw a rectangle around a button in it, and rest the pointer inside that rectangle: the BUTTON is what lights up.
Press ] once to climb out of the button and onto the rectangle you drew.

evaluate: Does the shape light up the instant the pointer is inside it, or is there a beat where nothing happens?
When you point inside a box you drew around a button, is the button the right first answer, or did you want your own box first?
Is the thin outline over your shape easy to see when the shape is the same red the ruler draws in?
Does ] climbing from a shape to the group holding it match the order you expect?
Is measuring your own shape this way faster than reading W and H off the panel, or is it the long way round?
rough: The outline drawn over the picked element is the measure ink at 70 percent, so over a shape filled in the same red it is nearly invisible. The first screenshot shows exactly that. Changing the ink is a look decision, so nothing was changed here.

A rotated or slanted shape is deliberately skipped: its box is stored unturned, so highlighting it would outline a rectangle that is not the shape you can see. It reads as a miss rather than as a wrong answer.
Gap mode and Alignment mode still read only the picture, so the whitespace between two shapes you drew is not measurable yet. Filed as its own task.
Both screenshots are real screen captures from the walk (Scripts/playtest/size-measures-a-drawn-shape-walk.json); the probe held the Screen Recording grant.
